name: Mayo Lake Minerals Inc.
summary: Mayo Lake Minerals Inc. is an early-stage mining company focused on identifying, acquiring, assessing, and exploring mineral prospects within Canada's Yukon Territory. The company primarily targets gold and silver deposits. Its key asset is an interest in the Carlin-Roop silver project, which consists of 186 claims covering 36.3 square kilometers in the eastern portion of the Keno Hill Silver District. Founded in 2011, Mayo Lake Minerals Inc. maintains its headquarters in Ottawa, Canada.
